d: A Duke's son leads his warriors against an evil baron and tries to destroy a galaxy-wide 'spice' trade.
A man from another world crash lands on Earth during the age of the Vikings.
When a terrifying Cyclops is terrorizing the Roman countryside the emperor sends in his strongest general.

The legendary Cimmerian warrior, Conan, fights an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as he realizes he is the only one who can save the great nations of Hyboria from an encroaching reign of supernatural evil.
